entries.title: Loren can now analyze deals + show results as a table inline
bullets: New capability: Deal Analyzer. Ask Loren to analyze / underwrite / 'run the numbers' on a property (or paste a listing URL) and she calls the existing analyze-deal engine and renders the report inline — summary + metrics. No analysis logic was duplicated; she wraps what you already built.
Results now have a cards / table toggle right in the conversation, so you can flip a search into a table view (query-page columns) without leaving the chat.
The full-grid hand-off (Open all N in the search table) stays for the complete, filterable results page.
entries.bench: orchestrator v7 · 2 capabilities (search + analyze) · inline table + deal report · 0 existing files modified
